fullPassage: In 1885, France sent the Statue of Liberty to New York in pieces as a diplomatic gift to the US, but one key component was not included: the pedestal. It cost approximately six million dollars in today’s money to build, and the organization entrusted with raising the funds fell short. Neither New York City tax-payer funds nor federal government funding was an available option. Other cities like Boston and San Francisco offered to pay for the base in exchange for relocating the statue to their territory. To keep the statue in New York City, Joseph Pulitzer, the renowned newspaper publisher, mounted a campaign appealing for donations from ordinary people nationwide. Those contributing over a dollar received a miniature replica of the statue, and all donor names were published in the newspaper. Within five months, the campaign raised the required funds from more than 160,000 citizens, enabling the statue finally to have its base for assembly. What Pulitzer had done was create the earliest example of the crowdsourcing model. Nowadays, instead of newspapers, people use online platforms to solicit not just money but also ideas and tasks from a large group of people for various projects. In return, donors usually receive a small gift as a token of appreciation.

ch: 자유의 여신상은 1885년 여러 조각으로 나뉘어 뉴욕에 도착했다.
받침대 건설 비용을 모으던 조직은 목표 금액을 다 채우지 못했다.
보스턴과 샌프란시스코 같은 도시들은 여신상을 자기 지역으로 옮기는 대가로 받침대 비용을 내겠다고 했다.

questions.passage: In 1885, France sent the Statue of Liberty to New York in pieces as a diplomatic gift to the US, but one key component was not included: the pedestal. It cost approximately six million dollars in today’s money to build, and the organization entrusted with raising the funds fell short. Neither New York City tax-payer funds nor federal government funding was an available option. Other cities like Boston and San Francisco offered to pay for the base in exchange for relocating the statue to their territory. To keep the statue in New York City, Joseph Pulitzer, the renowned newspaper publisher, mounted a campaign appealing for donations from ordinary people nationwide. Those contributing over a dollar received a miniature replica of the statue, and all donor names were published in the newspaper. Within five months, the campaign raised the required funds from more than 160,000 citizens, enabling the statue finally to have its base for assembly. What Pulitzer had done was create the earliest example of the crowdsourcing model. Nowadays, instead of newspapers, people use online platforms to solicit not just money but also ideas and tasks from a large group of people for various projects. In return, donors usually receive a small gift as a token of appreciation.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.analysis:
① 불일치 — 본문은 'all donor names were published in the newspaper'라 이름이 제외된 게 아니라 신문에 공개됨 ←정답
② 일치 — 'Within five months, the campaign raised the required funds from more than 160,000 citizens'
③ 일치 — 'What Pulitzer had done was create the earliest example of the crowdsourcing model'
④ 일치 — 'instead of newspapers, people use online platforms to solicit not just money but also ideas and tasks'
det.tip: published(공개)를 '제외'로 뒤집은 오답

ch: 1달러 이상 기부한 사람들은 기부자 명단에서 이름이 제외되었다.
5개월 만에 16만 명이 넘는 시민에게서 필요한 기금이 모였다.
풀리처가 한 일은 크라우드소싱 모델의 초기 사례를 만든 것이었다.
오늘날 사람들은 신문 대신 온라인 플랫폼으로 돈뿐 아니라 아이디어와 과제도 모은다.

det.korean: ③ raising → raised (이 문장의 본동사 자리이므로 과거동사 raised)
det.analysis:

빈칸 앞에 콤마가 있고 접속사·새 주어가 없어요. 앞 절(the campaign raised ~)을 이어 '그래서 ~하게 했다'로 부연하는 분사구문이므로 동사 enable을 현재분사 enabling으로 써야 해요

questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 [조건]에 주어진 단어를 모두 사용하여 빈칸에 알맞은 영어를 쓰시오. (영어로) 그리고 모든 기부자의 이름이 신문에 실렸다. Those contributing over a dollar received a miniature replica of the statue, and ______________________. (8단어)
[조건] (1) all, donor, in, names, newspaper, published, the, were를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 8단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: 주어 all donor names + 수동태 were published + 장소 in the newspaper
det.analysis:
주어 'all donor names(모든 기부자의 이름)'를 먼저 놓아요. 이름은 사람에 의해 '실리는(공개되는)' 대상이므로 수동태 were published(be동사+과거분사)를 써요. 마지막에 어디에 실렸는지 in the newspaper(신문에)를 붙여요
→ all donor names + were published + in the newspaper
det.tip: 주어 + were published(수동태) + in the newspaper(장소). 이름이 '실리는' 대상이라 수동
